svg.title: cg-02 Clock in (Caregiver Mobile App)
svg.desc: Three low-fidelity phone frames for clocking in to Frank Albrecht's 08:00-10:00 visit: A ready to clock in with a passed identity check and good GPS accuracy, B the low-accuracy warning state at 3,400 m, C the server result after clock-in showing 14 m from the service address. Numbered callouts 1 to 8.

g.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: C. Clocked in: result from Tendwell
Valid for this clock-in only: 01:12 left
Distance to the address is checked by Tendwell
when you clock in. Your phone does not decide it.
Records time, location and device for this visit.
Take a selfie so the office knows it is you.
GPS accuracy 3,400 m. Tendwell needs 100 m
or better to check the distance to the address.
Precise Location is off for Tendwell.
You can still clock in. The punch is saved and
marked Low GPS accuracy for the office to review.
